scope: original run selective resource restart with actual fresh M3 and Argus contexts

cases.condition: original sealed input contains valid exact consecutive future bindings and approvals
cases.expected: retain original initial tuple and all future contexts without consumption or launch

cases.condition: future context repeats an initial or other future execution ID, permit ID or nonce
cases.expected: reject before worker birth or journal mutation

cases.condition: future unit unknown, generation sparse/duplicated, joint capacity exceeded or approval mismatches any exact binding pin
cases.expected: reject admission; no inferred approval from native generation budget

cases.condition: selected exact future permit or approval expires before consumption
cases.expected: reject actual use; do not extend validity or manufacture a successor

cases.condition: old native wait/retirement or original C1 release is missing
cases.expected: no generation statement or fresh permit consumption

cases.condition: actual original normal stop/cleanup M3 record or Argus mirror is missing or damaged
cases.expected: same original worker rejects generation operation; missing evidence remains missing

cases.condition: copied generation statement, public descriptor or untrusted controller supplies binding/approval
cases.expected: reject before mutation; no adoption or permit minting

cases.condition: same original run restarts leaf generation1 to2 to3 while prerequisite remains running
cases.expected: distinct preapproved executions and once-only permit consumption; actual old waits and normal records; unchanged prerequisite handle/execution remains live

cases.condition: old native ticket or old readiness is presented after actual shared epoch advance
cases.expected: no Release; require new-generation Stage and actual fresh prerequisite probes

cases.condition: old matching stop/cleanup is repeated after a replacement generation starts
cases.expected: return cached original-generation terminal facts without touching the replacement

cases.condition: storage or AFFA is stopped during fresh intent, native ADVANCE or Stage
cases.expected: independent cancellation; actually fence all late creation/thaw before fallback release; unknown waits and normal records stay unknown

cases.condition: restart target has active transitive dependents
cases.expected: quiesce reverse dependency order, retain old evidence, then restart only through exact admitted contexts and new dependency probes

cases.condition: new generation starts within existing original run
cases.expected: same original journal/writer with all historical claims retained; no Argus root reopen, worker reset or global initial-generation rewrite
